user.title: SmartHeat Login
user.description: Sign in with your existing SmartHeat account or register on our website.

tenant.title: Select installation
tenant.description: The dropdown lists every heating installation linked to your account. Which one would you like to set up?

profile.title: Select profile
profile.description: Choose the three properties of your heating system: manufacturer, heat source, and heat distribution. The matching profile is determined automatically from this combination.

entities.title: Map entities
entities.description: Assign the matching Home Assistant entity to each role so the heating curve control can access the correct sensors and actuators.

kpi_metrics.title: Optional: performance metrics
kpi_metrics.description: This step is optional and only intended for the development phase. Optionally map additional sensors for performance logging; only fields supported by your profile are shown. You can leave everything empty and continue.

retry_push.title: Could not configure add-ons
retry_push.description:
MQTT credentials (apply manually if this keeps failing): {mqtt_username} / {mqtt_password}

{error_detail}

retry_push_hints.ambiguous_addon_match: Multiple matching add-on installations were found. Please remove the duplicate/outdated installation in the Supervisor, then try again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SmartHeat service
error.no_tenants: Subscribe on our website to get access to our heating control server.
error.profile_combination_unsupported: This combination is not supported yet
error.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.state_class_expected_measurement: Expected state class 'measurement' (entities without any state_class are also rejected)
error.state_class_expected_total_increasing: Expected state class 'total_increasing' (entities without any state_class are also rejected)

abort.not_supervisor: This integration only works on a Home Assistant installation with Supervisor (Home Assistant OS or Home Assistant Supervised), because it provisions real MQTT credentials and configures companion add-ons via the Supervisor API.
abort.already_configured: This installation is already configured. Remove the existing SmartHeat config entry first if you want to reconfigure it.
abort.no_verified_profiles: No verified profile is currently available on the SmartHeat server for this installation. Please try again later or contact support.
abort.invalid_provisioning_response: The SmartHeat server returned an incomplete setup response (profile parameters missing). Please try again later or contact support.
